business.name: The Adams Paradigm
business.tagline: Turning Ideas Into Powerful Digital Experiences.
business.description: Dean Adams builds modern websites, web applications, APIs and digital products for small businesses, startups and individuals.

about.summary: Dean Adams is a developer who enjoys taking ideas from rough concepts and turning them into functioning digital products. He works across the full process — planning, interface design, backend development, and shipping to real users.
bio: I'm a developer who enjoys taking ideas from rough concepts and turning them into functioning digital products. I like the full range of the process — planning how something should work, building the interface, wiring up the backend, and getting it in front of real users.

My focus is on building practical solutions: applications that connect a well-designed frontend to a solid backend, integrate cleanly with the APIs and services they depend on, and hold up in production — not just in a demo.
I'm always learning new technologies as they become useful, and I care about the details that make an application feel good to use, not just function correctly.

faqs.question: What does The Adams Paradigm do?
faqs.answer: The Adams Paradigm, run by Dean Adams, builds modern websites, web applications, APIs and digital products for small businesses, startups and individuals — from initial idea through to a live, working product.

faqs.question: Who is behind The Adams Paradigm?
faqs.answer: Dean Adams, a full-stack developer who handles the full process himself: planning, frontend, backend, integrations, testing and deployment.

faqs.question: What services do you offer?
faqs.answer: Full-Stack Web Development, Custom Software, API Development, React Applications, ASP.NET / C# Development, Database Solutions, Payment Integrations, Booking & Scheduling systems, AI-Powered Applications, Cloud & Deployment, a Basic Website package, and one-on-one Consults.

faqs.question: How much do your services cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing is hourly plus a one-time setup fee, in ZAR. Hourly rates range from R95–R160 depending on the service, with most setup fees at R500 (the Basic Website package has a R2,500 setup fee). Exact quotes depend on project scope.

faqs.question: How do I book a service?
faqs.answer: Go to the Booking section on the website, select a service, enter your name, surname and email, choose whether you're paying the setup fee or the hourly rate, and submit. You'll get a secure Yoco payment link instantly plus a confirmation email.

faqs.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: Payments are processed securely through Yoco, in South African Rand (ZAR).

faqs.question: Do you work with individuals or only businesses?
faqs.answer: Both — and startups too. Projects range from small business tools and startup MVPs to personal passion projects.

faqs.question: What technologies do you use?
faqs.answer: React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS on the frontend; C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core, Web APIs and SignalR on the backend; SQL Server and PostgreSQL for data; plus REST APIs, payment integrations, authentication, and AI APIs where useful.

faqs.question: What is your development process?
faqs.answer: Six steps: Discover, Plan, Build, Test, Launch, and Evolve — from understanding the problem through to a live product that keeps improving.

faqs.question: Can you build an MVP for my startup?
faqs.answer: Yes — MVPs and scalable product foundations for startups are a core part of the work.

faqs.question: Do you build AI-powered features?
faqs.answer: Yes, the AI-Powered Applications service covers practical AI integrations and intelligent features built into real products.

faqs.question: How do I get a quote?
faqs.answer: Use the Contact section and choose 'Request a Quote' (or 'Start a Project' / 'Book a Consultation' depending on where you're at), and describe the project.

faqs.question: How can I contact Dean directly?
faqs.answer: Email deanh.adams@gmail.com, or use the contact form on the website.

faqs.question: Can I see examples of past work?
faqs.answer: Yes — the Projects section showcases work including Complete The Eleven FC (an interactive football lineup game), Devil Bunny (an anime universe digital experience), World Quiz League (a real-time quiz platform concept), and FlowDesk (a business operations platform concept).

faqs.question: Are you currently taking on new projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, availability is currently open for new projects.
